item.description:
### Added - **Call Controls (`⌃ ⌥ ⌘ M` / `⌃ ⌥ ⌘ V`)** — unified global Mic and Video shortcuts that mute your system microphone and control FaceTime, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Slack, Google Meet, Discord, or custom call apps, paired with a draggable floating Mic/Camera status pill, output device cycling, and auto-mute while typing - **Clean Lock** — temporarily lock your keyboard (including media, volume, and brightness keys) and mouse/trackpad input for `10s`–`3m` with a center-screen countdown and `Hold ⌃ ⌥ ⌘ Esc (3s)` emergency unlock - **Clipboard History** — keep recent unpinned clipboard items across restarts by default, with a toggle in Privacy & Cleanup - **Developer Tools** — added live background update schedule diagnostics and a Call Controls simulation and telemetry workspace
### Changed - Expanded the **Dashboard** module grid up to 3 columns on wider windows and standardized **HUD Toast** height across all status icons
### Fixed - Stabilized the Call Controls floating pill position when toggling Mic or Camera and fixed a crash when closing the pill
